children: According to The Korea Herald, Hyundai Motor Group's autonomous driving subsidiary 42dot is working to close the technology gap with Tesla and Waymo while seeking to support market entry with Nvidia. The company is preparing to deploy its own Atria AI-powered vehicle fleet in 2029. At a media briefing at 42dot headquarters in Pangyo, Gyeonggi Province, Park Min-woo, 42dot CEO and head of Hyundai's advanced vehicle platform, said Hyundai's global annual sales of 7 million vehicles provide a foundation for the effort.

title: 42dot Targets 2029 Atria AI Fleet As Hyundai Motor Group Seeks Nvidia Partnership
